text.arabic_uthmani: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا

words.gloss_range: consequential connective that carries the completed construction into its result

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: connector-plus-negator surface cluster that joins consequence to negation

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the ayah land as consequence: after the construction and molten pour in 18:96, the failed attempts are reported as the result of that work. Because it is heard in {{ar:فَمَا}} ({{tr:fa-mā}}), consequence and negation arrive together rather than as two loose narrative beats.

topics.headline: consequence of the completed barrier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as the result of the construction in 18:96, not as an unrelated new scene.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) as consequential, and the boundary rows make the double inability depend on the completed construction in 18:96.

topics.headline: result and negation arrive as one surface unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears consequence and impossibility arrive together in {{ar:فَمَا}} ({{tr:fa-mā}}), so the grammar compresses cause and denial at the opening.
topics.reason: The connective is fused to the first negator, so the opening launches negated result immediately.

words.gloss_range: factual negation over the first capacity clause
words.prose: The first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) negates the whole capacity frame, not only the climbing verb. It begins the paired denial that will return at word 7, so the ayah first closes the over-route as a completed factual inability.

topics.headline: factual negation of capacity to scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first failure is stated as an established lack of capacity, not merely that the actors did not climb.
topics.reason: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) before the perfect capacity verb negates the whole ability clause with its complement.

topics.headline: first half of paired over-through denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the opening beat of a matched neither/nor structure that will close off over and through routes.
topics.reason: The second negator at word 7 and the coordinated clause confirm that this first negation begins an ordered double denial.

words.gloss_range: they were able / found capacity, locally negated and completed by an unrealized scaling complement
words.root_gloss_range: capacity and compliance field; local Form X selects ability while obedience/compliance remains a narrowed pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed scaling complement that specifies the failed capacity
later full Form X counterpart used for the heavier breach attempt

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:isṭāʿū}}) carries the unnamed plural actors into a completed failed test and takes {{ar:أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:an yaẓharūhu}}) as its specified task. Its shortened Form X makes the first route lighter beside the later full {{ar:ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaṭāʿū}}); the root’s compliance field also makes the finished barrier feel unwilling to yield, though local grammar keeps capacity as the selected sense. The recurrence of this capacity root elsewhere in Surah 18 (18:67; 18:72; 18:75; 18:78; 18:101) now lands as physical inability.

topics.headline: same unnamed actors fail a completed test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural ending carries the same opposing group forward without renaming them, and the perfect under negation presents the scaling test as already settled.
topics.reason: The third masculine plural perfect verb under negation keeps the discourse group as the subject of the failed test.

topics.headline: capacity is tied to a governed scaling event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ability is not left abstract: it is denied specifically with respect to the unrealized act of getting over the barrier.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:an yaẓharūhu}}) as the clausal complement of {{ar:ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:isṭāʿū}}).

topics.headline: capacity carries a compliance-root pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that failed ability is also framed as the finished barrier refusing to yield to the actors, while local grammar keeps capacity as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Obedience and compliance are retained as narrowed root pressure; the local Form X construction still selects ability.

topics.headline: shortened first capacity form contrasts with the later full form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first failed route has the lighter shortened capacity form, setting up the heavier full form before the boring attempt.
topics.reason: QAC notes tāʾ elision for word 3 and full Form X at word 8; variant rows support but do not govern the standard contrast.

topics.headline: Surah 18 capacity thread lands physically here
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a Surah 18 concern with capacity and endurance reappears here as a physical inability before the barrier.
topics.reason: The concrete Surah 18 references let the recurrence survive as contextual echo without overriding the local parse.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive/infinitival governor specifying the unrealized action

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: governed verb naming the unrealized scaling action
coordinated connector-plus-negator that restarts the second denial

words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) makes the blocked action explicit and unrealized: the issue is the capacity to perform {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}). Its scope stops before the next {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}), so the first half remains an {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}})-verb complement while the second half becomes target plus breach noun. The particle’s nasal close also works as a small hinge into the governed verb, making the complement sound bound to the capacity frame.

topics.headline: unrealized action made into content of inability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the following verb into the exact unrealized action that capacity fails to reach.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence agree that {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) governs {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}).

topics.headline: first complement stops before the second denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first half uses an {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}})-verb complement, while the second half resets into target plus noun.
topics.reason: The subordinate clause is bounded at word 5 before a coordinated second clause begins.

topics.headline: nasal hinge binds particle to governed verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the small particle as a hinge into the governed verb, reinforcing that the action belongs inside the capacity frame.
topics.reason: The sound claim aligns with the syntactic bond between particle and governed verb.

words.gloss_range: to surmount or get over it, with the barrier as direct object and the act unrealized under the negated ability clause
words.root_gloss_range: appearing, outward/top surface, support, and prevailing; local valency selects physical surmounting while appearance and dominance remain narrowed pressures

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: unselected prepositional prevail-over frame used only as a contrast
through-mass breach noun paired with the over-surface verb

words.prose: {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}) binds the barrier into the verb as direct object: they cannot surmount it, not merely move near it. The root’s surface and visibility field makes the failed ascent an attempt to reach the outward/top face and become visible over it, while dominance readings are only secondary because the verb does not use an {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) frame. As the over-surface member, it prepares the through-mass counterterm {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}); its pressed onset and release fit failed upward access, and the later leveling in 18:98 supplies the only resolution of that vertical pressure.

topics.headline: barrier carried as direct object of ascent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the barrier is not merely a location near the climbers; it is the object they try and fail to surmount.
topics.reason: The suffix on {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}) is syntactically forced as the direct object and resolves to the barrier built in 18:96.

topics.headline: surmounting draws on outer-surface and visibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that getting over the barrier is imagined as reaching its outward or top surface and becoming visible over it, while the direct-object frame keeps physical surmounting primary.
topics.reason: The root range supports appearance, surface, and support imagery, but local valency narrows the active sense to physical surmounting.

topics.headline: prevailing-over remains secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a denied dominance overtone in the failed ascent, but the absence of an {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) frame keeps climbing as the local parse.
topics.reason: Prevail-over rows are narrowed because the local verb takes a direct object suffix, not the usual prepositional frame.

topics.headline: over-surface member of the access binary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}) as the over-surface attempt that will be paired with the through-mass breach noun at the end.
topics.reason: The first clause closes on surmounting before the second clause turns to {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}).

topics.headline: pressed sound and later leveling frame the failed ascent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and tracks the failed upward access as a local pressure that will only be answered by the later leveling in 18:98.
topics.reason: The sound row is modest, and the forward bridge has a concrete reference to 18:98.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that functions as nor under repeated negation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: opening connector-plus-negator cluster answered by the second cluster
second connector-plus-negator cluster coordinating the renewed denial

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates the second denial as an equal clause, giving the sense of "nor" under repeated negation. It is the hinge where the ayah turns from the over-route to the through-route, while {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) echoes the opening {{ar:فَمَا}} ({{tr:fa-mā}}) with a new connective role.

topics.headline: second denial is coordinate, not subordinate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second failed route is added as an equal denial, giving the sense of "nor" without losing the coordinating force of {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}).
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verbal clause as coordinated, and repeated negation makes the conjunction function as a nor-link.

topics.headline: hinge from over-route to through-route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the particle as the hinge where the ayah changes physical strategy from over the barrier to through it.
topics.reason: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) coordinates equal clauses while different verb forms and complements preserve asymmetry.

topics.headline: connector-plus-negator echoes the opening cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears {{ar:وَمَا}} ({{tr:wa-mā}}) answer {{ar:فَمَا}} ({{tr:fa-mā}}): same negating beat, new connective role.
topics.reason: The formal echo compares connector-plus-negator clusters without conflicting with syntactic coordination.

words.gloss_range: second factual negator, restarting scope over the through-barrier attempt

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: full second capacity frame over which the repeated negator scopes

words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) restarts factual negation over {{ar:ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:istaṭāʿū lahu naqban}}). That repeated negative beat gives the penetration attempt its own denial and closes the remaining through-route rather than letting it survive as an untested possibility.

topics.headline: fresh factual denial over the breach attempt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boring attempt receives its own full negative scope rather than relying on the first negation by carryover.
topics.reason: The repeated {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) before a perfect verb restarts factual negation over {{ar:ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:istaṭāʿū lahu naqban}}).

topics.headline: negation closes the residual through-route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that after scaling fails, tunneling does not remain as a residual possibility; the second negation closes it as its own tested route.
topics.reason: The second negation combines with the target phrase and indefinite breach noun, denying any attainable opening.

topics.headline: repeated negator completes the double frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a return of the first negative beat, making the two failures matched rather than appended.
topics.reason: The repetition is explicit at words 2 and 7 and supports the neither/nor architecture.

words.gloss_range: full Form X capacity verb, locally negated and completed by target phrase plus breach noun
words.root_gloss_range: capacity and compliance field; local grammar selects failed ability while the full form makes seeking-capacity overt

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: target phrase plus breach product completing the second ability verb

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaṭāʿū}}) repeats the capacity test with the same plural actors, but now the verb takes {{ar:لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:lahu naqban}}): a target plus a concrete breach product. Its full Form X makes the seeking-capacity shape overt and restores the weight absent from the earlier shortened verb, fitting the more sustained task of boring through. The compliance-root pressure survives as matter refusing to yield, while the local sense remains failed ability; the common capacity field is also specialized by the rare breach noun that extends failure from ascent to penetration.

topics.headline: ability verb takes target plus breach product
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second capacity verb is completed not by another action clause but by a target and a concrete breach-result.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) as complement and {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) as explicit object.

topics.headline: same plural actors fail the second completed test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same unnamed plural actors are tested again, with the same factual completed inability now applied to penetration.
topics.reason: The perfect plural ending and implicit-argument evidence keep the second failed capacity clause attached to the same group.

topics.headline: full Form X marks the heavier boring side
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second ability verb restores the fuller form just where the task becomes sustained boring through the barrier.
topics.reason: QAC contrasts the full word 8 form with the shortened word 3 form, and {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) makes the heavier task local.

topics.headline: capacity root becomes sustained failed compliance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the full capacity form makes their search for capacity visible, while local grammar keeps being able rather than simple obedience as the selected sense.
topics.reason: Compliance rows are narrowed because {{ar:ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟}} ({{tr:istaṭāʿū}}) is locally an ability verb, though matter’s refusal to yield remains a payoff.

topics.headline: common capacity field narrowed to rare breach task
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the repeated capacity root is specialized by the uncommon breach noun, extending the failure from ascent to penetration.
topics.reason: The repeated capacity root is locally specialized by the breach complement and the completed barrier from 18:96.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus pronoun, marking the known barrier as the target or adversarial object of breach

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: unselected surface-on framing used only as a contrast
unselected inside-location framing used only as a contrast
breach product named after the target pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) carries the same known barrier into the second frame without renaming it. The lām marks the barrier as the target or adversarial object of penetration, not a surface stood upon with {{ar:عَلَيْهِ}} ({{tr:ʿalayhi}}) or an inside-space already entered with {{ar:فِيهِ}} ({{tr:fīhi}}). Because this fused preposition-pronoun comes before {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}), the target is heard before the breach product, and the same barrier pronoun shifts from climbed direct object to genitive target of penetration.

topics.headline: same known barrier carried into the second frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second attempt targets the same constructed barrier without renaming it, so both failures remain bound to one object.
topics.reason: Attachment and cross-reference evidence resolve the suffix in {{ar:لَهُۥ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) to the same barrier referred to by word 5.

topics.headline: lām marks adversarial target before breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the barrier is marked as the target or adversarial object of penetration, not as a surface stood upon or an inside space already entered.
topics.reason: The lām-governed pronoun suits the following breach noun and targets the barrier before any successful inside-space exists.

topics.headline: target marking and pronoun tracking fuse before the noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that target and referent are fused in one short word and heard before the breach noun, making the barrier the frame before the product is named.
topics.reason: The bound form combines lām and suffix, and its position before {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) gives an ordering payoff.

topics.headline: same pronoun shifts from climbed object to breach target
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same barrier pronoun changes grammatical role: direct object in the ascent verb, genitive after lām in the penetration frame.
topics.reason: The forced attachments support the shift from object suffix to prepositional pronoun.

words.gloss_range: an indefinite accusative verbal noun naming a breach, tunnel, or boring-through as the result they cannot achieve
words.root_gloss_range: perforating, passage through, probing/investigating, and related oversight derivatives; the barrier frame selects physical breach while probing remains narrowed pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: over-surface verb paired with the final through-mass noun

words.prose: {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) closes the ayah on a denied breach-result: an indefinite accusative verbal noun under negation, so even one opening is unavailable. The root field supplies perforation, passage through mass, probing, and the search for a starting point, all narrowed by the barrier context to physical penetration. It completes the over/through inventory begun by {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}), gains weight from low occurrence and root links at 5:12 and 50:36, answers the seamless pour of 18:96, and leaves the ear on denied access through hard stop pressure and final tanwīn before 18:98 names the promised leveling.

topics.headline: breach is a denied achieved result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names the breach as a result they cannot produce, not merely an ongoing digging process.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) as an accusative verbal noun/object.

topics.headline: negation denies even one possible opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular indefinite under negation denies any breach-instance at all, even the minimum opening.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite noun sits under the second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), so the denial ranges over possible openings.

topics.headline: perforation, route, spot, and probing concentrate in physical breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word is not a generic hole: its root field evokes perforating, a route through mass, a searched entry point, and probing, while the barrier frame selects physical breach.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:lahu naqban}}) selects physical penetration; investigative and spot/mark senses survive as narrowed pressure.

topics.headline: final word completes the over-through spatial inventory
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close the two main bypass routes: over the visible surface and through the mass.
topics.reason: {{ar:يَظْهَرُوهُ}} ({{tr:yaẓharūhu}}) supplies over-surface access and {{ar:نَقْبًۭا}} ({{tr:naqban}}) supplies through-mass access.

topics.headline: rare breach noun gains weight from other root occurrences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this low-occurrence breach form is load-bearing here, with other root occurrences sharpening probing or passage contrasts at 5:12 and 50:36.
topics.reason: The input marks {{ar:ن ق ب}} ({{tr:n-q-b}}) as low occurrence for this form, with concrete references to 5:12 and 50:36.

topics.headline: ayah lands on denied access and points to divine resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends on the unavailable breach, while 18:98 supplies the later transformation humans cannot perform.
topics.reason: The final position, prior molten pour in 18:96, and forward link to 18:98 give the word closure force.

topics.headline: stop sounds and final tanwīn audibly close the breach attempt
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a hard stop-and-closure texture at the final word, with tanwīn linking the ending cadence toward 18:98.
topics.reason: The sound rows describe qāf/bāʾ stop pressure and final tanwīn as closure without controlling the lexical parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated capacity negation is distributed across يَظْهَرُوهُ and نَقْبًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first failure denies ascent or dominance over the barrier; the second denies an opening through it. Vertical exterior access and transverse interior access are separately closed.

activation_trace.role: Capacity and executability supply the repeated modal frame for both failed operations.
Height, mastery, and ascent define the overt route over the barrier.
Opening a hole to what lies beyond defines the covert route through the barrier.

changed_reading.before: They could neither climb it nor make a hole in it.
changed_reading.after: The verse inventories a complete two-axis defeat: no mastery of the exterior height and no access through the interior mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both predicates are governed by forms of استطاع from ط و ع.
baseline_models.mechanism: The capacity root also carries compliance and yielding. Repetition therefore permits inability to be read relationally: neither the barrier nor the operation becomes tractable to the agents, rather than the verse merely assigning them a low quantity of strength.

activation_trace.role: Compliance and being led supply the image of material or action yielding to an agent.
Executable capacity keeps that yielding anchored to the actual modal verbs.
A through-opening is the concrete operation that never becomes executable.

changed_reading.before: The attackers simply lacked enough power.
changed_reading.after: Agent, tool, route, and material never entered a workable relation: the barrier would not become manageable either above or through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظهر can concern what is exposed or discovered, while نقب can concern penetrating and searching interiors.
baseline_models.mechanism: The paired objects of incapacity can exceed two motions and mark two access regimes: gaining the disclosed upper face and probing hidden interior structure.

activation_trace.role: Emergence and disclosure make the outer face an unavailable field of access.
Discovery and finding out extend overtopping toward reconnaissance without leaving the focus verb.
Searching interiors and reports makes boring a possible image of probing for hidden knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The statement reports only failed physical movement.
changed_reading.after: Alongside the physical sense, it closes exterior overview and interior probing as complementary channels of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The travel sequence repeatedly couples empowerment with a connecting means, pursuit, and arrival at limits. Against that mobile pattern, 18:97 is a designed reversal: the opposing agents cannot convert intention into either an over-route or a through-route.

activation_trace.role: Empowerment supplies the narrative's positive capacity pole.
A rope or connection supplies a usable means linking agent to destination.
Following until catching or reaching turns means into directed traversal.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the completed traversal repeatedly achieved before the focus.
Repeated failed capacity reverses the preceding pattern of enabled movement.
Ascent or mastery is the first route the reversal closes.
A pass through hard terrain is the second route the reversal closes.

structural_cues: 18:84-93 repeats empowerment, means, following, and reaching before the paired negations of 18:97.
The focus coordinates an over-route and a through-route rather than issuing one undifferentiated claim of strength.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enabled travel followed by two failed traversals; I infer that the constructed barrier terminates route affordances. A live alternative is that the travel pattern characterizes only the builder and does not intentionally contrast with the attackers.

changed_reading.before: A strong wall happens to stop two attacks.
changed_reading.after: The wall reverses the pericope's grammar of mobility: means repeatedly carry the builder to limits, while no means can carry the attackers across this limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prior construction fills a gap, masses iron pieces between elevated mountain sides, equalizes the span, heats it by blown fire, and pours molten copper over it. This staged interface gives separate causal force to the two failures: terrain-spanning geometry frustrates overtopping, while consolidated and coated mass frustrates perforation.

activation_trace.role: Filling a breach establishes closure of the terrain gap as the project's function.
Collected blocks supply discrete mass that can be assembled into the closure.
Iron and resistant hardness supply the barrier's load-bearing material.
Equalizing two sides supplies the geometry that removes a lower crossing point.
Elevated mountain sides make the constructed mass continuous with natural height.
Driven air supplies the process that intensifies the heating stage.
Kindled fire supplies the thermal transformation of the assembled iron.
Pouring by emptying a vessel supplies a continuous applied layer.
Molten copper identifies the poured material that closes or coats the exterior.
Failed ascent tests the completed height and terrain geometry.
Failed boring tests the completed mass and surface continuity.

structural_cues: 18:96 orders material, equalization, blowing, heating, and pouring through successive commands and حتى clauses.
18:97 immediately reports two performance outcomes against the completed object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies materials, geometry, heat, and pouring; I infer that these stages jointly cause resistance to different attack vectors. The live alternative is that the verse reports successful construction without inviting a process-level engineering explanation.

changed_reading.before: The finished object is generically too strong to cross.
changed_reading.after: The paired failures are performance tests of a terrain-bonded, layered construction: its height denies ascent and its consolidated surface denies a through-opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: The builder's empowerment is joined to requested assistance and strength figured as gathered rope-strands, then converted into manufacture. Capacity in 18:97 is thus socially and technically organized: coordinated labor produces an object that opposing effort cannot make compliant.

activation_trace.role: Granted empowerment supplies authority and practical capacity on the construction side.
Assistance makes the project explicitly cooperative rather than solitary.
Strength gathered like rope-strands images force as coordinated multiplicity.
Making converts distributed capacity into a durable artifact.
The attackers' repeated non-capacity forms the negative pole of the social asymmetry.
Non-yielding makes the finished artifact retain the builders' organized force against later agents.

structural_cues: 18:95 moves from what has empowered the leader to a plural request for assistance with strength.
18:96 uses plural imperatives for supplying material and blowing before 18:97's plural failed attempts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies granted empowerment, cooperative aid, gathered strength, manufacture, and later incapacity; I infer that coordination is stored in the artifact and defeats uncoordinated assault. The alternative is that both plural groups are equally coordinated and only material hardness matters.

changed_reading.before: One side is naturally stronger than the other.
changed_reading.after: Capacity is not a fixed possession: coordinated people, authority, technique, and material are assembled into durable agency that later attackers cannot reproduce.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wider sequence first presents people with no covering, then a threatened community seeking separation from disorder, and finally names this construction mercy. The impermeability of 18:97 can therefore be read from the protected side as successful shelter, not only from the blocked side as defeat.

activation_trace.role: Absent covering establishes exposure as an earlier condition in the pericope.
Departure from sound order supplies the threat against which separation is requested.
Mercy explicitly supplies the beneficent valuation of the completed barrier.
Denied overtopping keeps the threatening side outside the protected space.
Denied perforation preserves the covering's integrity.

structural_cues: 18:90 negates any ستر for one people; 18:94 requests a separating barrier for another; 18:98 calls the finished work mercy.
The focus reports impermeability between the request for protection and its merciful valuation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, a disordering threat, successful exclusion, and the label mercy; I infer a contrast in which engineered impermeability functions as shelter. The alternative is that the exposed eastern people and the protected community are separate episodes with no designed contrast.

changed_reading.before: The ayah humiliates agents who cannot defeat a barrier.
changed_reading.after: The same incapacity is the measurable success of mercy from the protected community's side: neither the upper edge nor the protective skin can be violated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate next ayah places the barrier's destruction at the arrival of an appointed, true promise. Human inability in 18:97 is therefore absolute only within the present interval; it is neither intrinsic eternity nor independence from divine timing.

activation_trace.role: The paired incapacity establishes the barrier's present resistance to human action.
Arrival supplies the transition from the protected interval to its endpoint.
An appointment bounded by time or place makes the barrier's duration scheduled rather than indefinite.
Demolition to level ground supplies the exact reversal of height and mass.
Truth fixed against falsehood guarantees the announced reversal.

structural_cues: 18:98 immediately follows the double human inability with فإذا and a future condition.
The promised leveling reverses both elevation and solid closure from the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present incapacity followed by an appointed arrival and guaranteed demolition; I infer a bounded protective interval. The alternative is to treat 18:98 solely as a theological coda rather than a qualification of 18:97's apparent absoluteness.

changed_reading.after: It is impregnable to these agents now but deliberately temporary: the same height and mass that humans cannot undo will be leveled when the true appointment arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because the immediate actions are physical, but it remains anchored in the packet's discovery and interior-search branches for the two focus roots and is sharpened by nearby encompassing knowledge and failed understanding. Render only as an epistemic resonance alongside, not instead of, the engineering sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired focus roots can denote discovering what appears and investigating what lies within.

activation_trace.role: Finding out or gaining discovery makes the upper route a possible reconnaissance position.
Searching interiors and reports makes the through-route a possible probe for hidden conditions.
Complete encompassing in knowledge supplies the contrasting positive model of access.
Knowledge of the inner matter names the informational depth denied to adversarial probing.
Nearby difficulty of understanding supplies a human communication limit parallel to inaccessible structure.

changed_reading.before: The barrier blocks bodies and tools only.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also denies hostile legibility: no overview from above and no probing access to hidden structure or protected conditions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The س ط ع reading is form-distant from the dominant capacity root, but the packet explicitly preserves it as a non-dominant mapped inventory and the shorter first surface precedes the ascent predicate. Render as a sonic and topological shadow, never as a replacement morphology or a lexical correction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first, shorter capacity surface ٱسْطَٰعُوا۟ stands immediately before the failed act of rising over the barrier.

activation_trace.role: Extension and rising in air cast a vertical shadow across the packet's split mapping of the capacity forms.
Ascent and dominance give that vertical shadow a direct syntactic landing point.
Elevated mountain sides provide the spatial image against which attempted rising fails.

changed_reading.before: Both capacity forms contribute only identical modal meaning.
changed_reading.after: The clipped first form carries an exploratory echo of upward extension exactly where the sentence tests ascent, while the full second form returns to ordinary capacity before boring.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rust sense of ن ق ب is remote from the direct noun meaning of a breach, yet it is focus-anchored and becomes materially live beside packet-supplied iron, pouring, and molten copper. Render only as a possible corrosion or surface-integrity echo; do not claim that the verse states a metallurgical anti-rust design.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun نَقْبًا has a packet branch for rust mounting iron as well as the direct through-hole branch.

activation_trace.role: Rust that mounts iron introduces a slow surface-failure image inside the focus root's inventory.
Explicit iron and resistant hardness provide the substrate that makes the rust branch materially relevant.
Pouring supplies the act that applies an exterior layer.
Molten copper supplies the poured material whose surface relation to iron activates the analogy.

changed_reading.before: No attacker can punch a hole through the barrier.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory material edge, even the idea of an iron skin beginning to fail from rust or perforation is held outside the successful result.

strongest_changes: Repeated empowerment, connecting means, pursuit, and arrival reverse into an engineered denial of both available routes.
The construction sequence explains the paired failures through terrain, geometry, massed iron, heating, and poured copper.
The next ayah makes present impermeability merciful in function yet strictly time-bounded by a true promise of demolition.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled capacity verb and the exterior/interior pair sustained relational, material, social, protective, epistemic, and temporal readings without forcing one synthesis; the split س ط ع mapping and the rust-on-iron branch preserved packet-specific surprises.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the shorter first capacity form should carry the packet's س ط ع rise-and-extension shadow or only the dominant ط و ع capacity sense.
Whether exterior and interior access bear an epistemic resonance beyond their primary physical engineering.
Whether the rust branch has intentional material force here or remains only a lexicographic outlier.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The structure denies two distinct affordances.** `ط و ع` B001’s yielding image lies inside both capacity forms: the barrier yields neither to scaling nor piercing. Moses’ self did not yield to delayed judgment (18:67–78), and the garden’s water ceased to yield to seeking (18:41). I infer that inability can arise from agent, object, or relation. Here engineered material resistance converts hostile intention into ineffectiveness.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:98 showed engineered non-yielding itself yielding to divine appointment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Both over-route and through-route are closed.** `ن ق ب/B001` is perforating an opening; `ن ق ب/B005` is a pass through rough high ground, and `B006` is traversing lands in search of escape. The balanced negations test ascent over the barrier and perforation through it; 18:98 then names its eventual leveling, and 18:99 replaces controlled separation with wave-like intermingling. I infer that the construction succeeds by eliminating alternative path geometries, not by merely appearing tall. `نَقْبًا` reads as denied route-production.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:98’s promised leveling and 18:99’s immediate surge showed that denied route-production is temporary containment, not absolute impossibility.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir yüzeyi delip açıklığı öte yana ya da altındaki dokuya ulaştırma çekirdeğini; bunun duvar, deri ve beden üzerindeki uygulamalarını, kullanılan aracı ve bazı özel sonuçları birlikte doğrular.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel delip açma çekirdeğini korurken araç ve köpek boğazına ilişkin sözlüksel kullanımları bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir duvarı, deriyi ya da bedeni delerek açıklığı öteki yana veya alttaki katmana kadar ulaştırmaktır; ayrıca bu işte kullanılan aleti ve belirli beden bölgelerine uygulanan özel işlemleri adlandırabilir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi delip açarak ötesine ya da altındaki katmana ulaşma işlemini bildirir.
Veterinerlikte hayvanın göbek bölgesini bir aletle delme ve köpeğin sesini zayıflatmak için boğazını delme uygulamalarını kapsar.
Delme aletini, delinen yeri ve duvar diye adlandırılan bir nesneyi de kapsayan adlaşmış kullanımları vardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bir nesnede açılan deliğin öte yana veya alttaki dokuya kadar ilerlemesidir. Duvar ve deri temel uygulama alanlarıdır; veterinerlik örnekleri ile alet ve yer adları bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duvar, deri veya beden üzerinde açılan deliğin karşı tarafa ya da alttaki katmana ulaşmasını anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Delme işlemini, açıklığın ilerlemesini ve öte yana ulaşma sonucunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duvar veya deri gibi bir yüzeyde işlemin nesnesi ve ulaştığı taraf bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığında doğal bir kullanımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yüzeyi delme ve onda açıklık oluşturma işlemini korur.
error_profile.adds: Deliğin mutlaka öte yana ya da alt katmana ulaşmadığı sıradan delme durumlarını da kapsayabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Delme işinde kullanılan metal araçtan söz edilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çekirdek delme işlemiyle araç arasındaki doğrudan bağı korur.
error_profile.loses: İşlemin kendisini, delinen yeri ve öte yana ulaşma sonucunu karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sesi zayıflatılmak üzere boğazı delinmiş köpek

error_profile.preserves: Bir açıklıktan öte yana geçme çağrışımını dolaylı biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir nesneyi delerek açıklık oluşturma işlemini ve bu işlemin katmanlar arası ilerlemesini yitirir.
error_profile.adds: Doğal arazi içindeki yolu ve ulaşım işlevini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün dağ yolu dalıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Açıklığın öte yana veya alt dokuya ulaşması, veterinerlik uygulamaları ve adlaşmış araç kullanımları bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Genel olarak delinmiş nesneyi ve delici aracı, belirli bir duvar ya da beden uygulamasına bağlanmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir nesnede delik açılması ve deliğin nesneyi aşması çekirdeğinde buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal, açma işlemini belirli yüzeyler ve alttaki katmana ulaşma sonucu üzerinden kurar; komşu ise daha genel bir delme ve geçirgen delik alanına sahiptir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en yakın karışma genel delip geçirme dalıyla olduğundan yalnızca bu sınır yayımlandı.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النقب في الحائط والجدار والجلد والجسد وسرة الدابة وحنجرة الكلب، وآلة النقب ومكانه والحائط المسمى منقبة
branches.source_phrase_ar: النقب في الحائط ونحوه يخلص فيه إلى ما وراءه وفي الجسد يخلص فيه إلى ما تحته؛ البيطار ينقب في بطن الدابة بالمنقب (ayn)؛ المنقب كل ما نقب به؛ المنقبة الحائط؛ منقبة الحديدة التي ينقب بها البيطار (jamhara)؛ نقب الجدار نقبا؛ نقب البيطار سرة الدابة؛ وتلك الحديدة منقب والمكان منقب (sihah)؛ نقبت الحائط أي بلغت في النقب آخره؛ كلب نقيب وهو أن ينقب حنجرة الكلب؛ البيطار ينقب في بطن الدابة بالمنقب (tahdhib)؛ النقب في الحائط والجلد كالثقب في الخشب؛ نقب البيطار سرة الدابة بالمنقب (mufradat)؛ أصل صحيح يدل على فتح في شيء؛ نقب الحائط؛ البيطار ينقب سرة الدابة؛ كلب نقيب نقبت غلصمته (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الناقبة القرحة التي تهجم على الجوف، والنقبة أول الجرب، وداء الضجعة المسمى ناقبة
يدخل فيه نقب الخف الملبوس وخف البعير وفرسنه إذا رق أو حفي حتى تخرق، وأنقب القوم إذا نقبت إبلهم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan kılıç, kesici uçlar ve demir üzerinde oluşan pası adlandırır; geçici çerçeve hem nesneyi hem yüzeyi kaplayan bozulmayı doğru verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın pas adını korur ve yalnızca demir, kılıç ve kesici metal yüzeylerdeki kullanımı kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Kılıç, kesici metal uç veya başka bir demir yüzeyin üstüne yerleşen pas tabakasıdır.

facets.statement: Demir yüzeyini kaplayan pası bildirir.
Kılıç ve kesici metal uçlar bu pasın özellikle anıldığı nesnelerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak alanı, demir ve özellikle kılıç ile kesici uçlar üzerinde beliren pastır. Verilen çoğul ve fiil kullanımları da aynı yüzey bozulmasını gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kılıç, kesici uç veya genel bir demir yüzey üzerindeki pas için tam ve doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Metal türünü ve yüzeyi kaplayan pas olma özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Metalin demir olduğu bağlamdan açıkça anlaşıldığında yüzeydeki oluşumu anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Yüzeyi kaplayan pas niteliğini açıkça korur.
error_profile.adds: Bağlam verilmezse demir dışındaki metallerin yüzey bozulmalarını da çağrıştırabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnızca demir, kılıç ve kesici uçların üstündeki pası adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kir tabakasını ve uzun süre parlatılmamış kılıcın bakımsızlığını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kılıç veya metal yüzeyinde oluşan paslı görünümü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal doğrudan pasın adıdır; komşu dal pasın yanı sıra kirlenmeyi ve parlatılmadan bırakılma durumunu da içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kir ve bakımsızlığı da içeren pas komşusu, bu dalın yalnızca pasla sınırlı olduğunu en iyi gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النقب أو النقبة بمعنى الصدأ الذي يعلو السيف والنصال والحديد
branches.source_phrase_ar: النقب الصدأ الذي يعلو السيف والنصال (ayn)؛ النقبة الصدأ يركب الحديد وجمعه نقب؛ نقب النصال (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dağ, tepe, sert arazi ve yüksek yerlerde bulunan görünür, dar ya da geçit veren yolu birlikte doğrular; dal çerçevesi yolu hareket eyleminden ayırarak doğru sınırlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yol adını esas alır ve dağlık ya da sert arazideki görünür, dar veya geçit veren yol sınırını korur.

concept_map.definition: Dağ, tepe veya sert ve yüksek arazide uzanan; görünür, dar ya da bir yandan öte yana geçit veren yoldur.

facets.statement: Dağlık veya sert arazide bulunan yolu bildirir.
Yol kimi anlatımlarda tepelerin üstünde görünür, kimilerinde dar, kimilerinde ise dağları aşan geçit niteliğindedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, dağ ve benzeri sert veya yüksek arazideki yolu ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Yolun görünür, dar ya da içinden geçilebilir olması birbirini dışlamayan betimleme çeşitleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dağlık veya sert arazide öte yana geçiş sağlayan yol için en kısa doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık araziyi, yol olma niteliğini ve geçiş işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Her kullanımda zorunlu olmayan geçit işlevini öne çıkarıp yalnızca görünür ya da dar dağ yolu anlatımını daraltır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolun dağ, tepe veya sert arazide bulunması öne çıktığında en geniş doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yolun dağlık arazide bulunması çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.adds: Görünürlük, darlık ya da geçit verme koşulu taşımayan sıradan dağ yollarını da kapsayabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kaynak bağlamı yolun dar oluşunu özellikle belirttiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağlık arazi, yol ve darlık özelliklerini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genişçe olabilen görünür veya geçit veren yol çeşitlerini dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dağlık veya sert arazideki geçit yolu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yolun görünür, dar veya dağ içinden geçit veren çeşitlerini ve sert arazi kapsamını birlikte taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeği doğrudan dağ içindeki ya da dağ üzerindeki yoldur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel bir dağ yolu adıdır; bu dal aynı çekirdeği görünürlük, darlık, yüksek arazi ve geçit verme gibi daha ayrıntılı sınırlarla kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dar olabilen ve sert ya da yüksek arazi üzerinde uzanabilen yol bu dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki dağ arasındaki geniş açıklığı, geniş vadiyi ve daha genel uzak yolu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dağlık alanda geçiş sağlayan yolu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal darlığa ve sert arazi üzerindeki geçide açıkken komşu dal belirgin biçimde geniş ve iki yükselti arasında açılmış bir yol alanındadır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün yol ve kök içi adaylar değerlendirildi; genel dağ yolu ile geniş dağ aralığı, darlık ve geçit sınırını en yararlı biçimde açıklar.
branches.branch_image_ar: طريق نافذ في جبل أو غلظ
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النقب والمنقب والمنقبة بمعنى الطريق الظاهر أو الضيق أو النافذ في الجبال والآكام والروابي والغلظ والقف والميل
branches.source_phrase_ar: النقب طريق ظاهر على رؤوس الجبال والآكام والروابي؛ وهو المنقبة أيضا (ayn)؛ النقاب الطريق في الغلظ أو في القف (jamhara)؛ النقب الطريق في الجبل وكذلك المنقب والمنقبة (sihah)؛ النقب في الجبل الطريق؛ النقاب جمع النقب وهو الطريق الضيق في الميل (tahdhib)؛ المنقبة طريق منفذ في الجبال (mufradat)؛ النقب والمنقبة الطريق في الجبل (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نقب الرجل أو القوم في البلاد إذا ساروا أو جاسوا أو ضربوا في الآفاق أو فتشوا وطلبوا المخرج
يدخل فيه النقيب بمعنى عريف القوم أو شاهدهم أو ضمينهم أو أمينهم أو كفيلهم أو رئيسهم، ونقب على قومه، وأنقب إذا صار نقيبا أو حاجبا

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi haberleri ve durumları araştıran, gizli yönlere nüfuz eden, bilgili ve güçlü sezgili kişiyi merkez alır; dal çerçevesi araştırma ile kavrayış sonucunu birlikte korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın kişi ve nitelik kullanımını esas alır; araştırma, bilgi ve güçlü sezgi bileşenlerini birlikte tutar.

concept_map.definition: Haberlerin ve durumların gizli yönlerini araştırıp ortaya çıkaran, konulara derinlemesine giren, bilgili, kavrayışlı ve güçlü sezgili kişidir.

facets.statement: Haberleri, olayları ve insanların durumlarını araştırıp gizli yönlerini ortaya çıkarma niteliğini bildirir.
Bu kişi bilgili, keskin kavrayışlı ve güçlü sezgisiyle doğru çıkarım yapabilen biridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, haberleri ve durumları araştırarak görünmeyen bilgiye ulaşan kişiyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Bilginlik, keskin kavrayış, doğru sezgi ve düşüncenin nüfuzu bu araştırma yeteneğinin nitelikleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Araştırma eylemi ile bilgi, kavrayış ve sezgi niteliğini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Gizli bilgiyi araştırmayı, derin kavrayışı ve bilgili kişi niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin topluluk adına haber ve durum araştırması yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Haberleri araştırıp ortaya çıkarma görevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel bilginliği, keskin kavrayışı ve güçlü sezgiyi açıkça karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Doğru çıkarım, güçlü sezgi ve konuya derin nüfuz etme yönü öne çıktığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Keskin kavrayış, güçlü sezgi ve bilgi niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Haber ve durumları etkin biçimde araştırma eylemini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: derinlemesine araştıran, bilgili ve keskin sezgili kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Araştırmayı yapan kişinin bilgin, keskin kavrayışlı ve güçlü sezgili niteliği bu dalda kurucu bir öğedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Soru sorma, haber isteme, sır açığa çıkarma ve bilgi arama eylemlerini kişide kalıcı bir nitelik gerektirmeden kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da haberin veya gizli bir durumun araştırılarak öğrenilmesi alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal araştırıcı kişinin yerleşik bilgi ve kavrayış gücünü adlandırır; komşu dal ise bilgiye ulaşmak için yapılan soruşturma eylemlerinin genel alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün araştırma, kavrayış ve kök içi adaylar değerlendirildi; haber ve sır araştırma komşusu eylem ile kalıcı kişi niteliği arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تنقيب الأخبار والأمور، والنقاب أو النقيب العالم بالأشياء والباحث عنها والفطن المصيب الظن
branches.source_phrase_ar: النقباء الذين ينقبون الأخبار والأمور للقوم؛ النقاب الحبر العالم (ayn)؛ رجل نقاب إذا كان مصيب الظن (jamhara)؛ النقاب الرجل العلامة؛ نقاب يحدث بالغائب (sihah)؛ النقاب الرجل العالم بالأشياء الباحث عنها الفطن الشديد الدخول فيها؛ ما لهم نقيبة أي نفاذ رأي (tahdhib)؛ النقيب الباحث عن القوم وعن أحوالهم (mufradat)؛ النقاب العالم بالأمور كأنه نقب عليها فاستنبطها أو العالم بها المنقب عنها (maqayis)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النقيبة بمعنى يمن العمل أو النفس أو الأمر أو المشورة أو حسن الخليقة أو نفاذ الرأي، ويدخل فيه نقيمة بالإبدال عن نقيبة
يدخل فيه المنقبة والمناقب بمعنى كرم الفعال والخصال الجميلة والنجدات وما يضاد المثلبة

branches.branch_image_ar: لون الوجه وهيئته وما يظهر منه
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النقبة بمعنى اللون، ونقبة الوجه أو الثور، وأثر الشيء وهيئته، وحسن النقبة
يدخل فيه النقاب وما انتقبت به المرأة وما تدنيه إلى المحجر أو المارن أو الأنف، وفعل انتقبت المرأة
يدخل فيه النقبة ثوبا كالإزار أو قميصا قصيرا أو خرقة لها حجزة أو تكة، وفعل نقبت الثوب إذا جعلته نقبة
يدخل فيه ناقبت فلانا ولقيته نقابا إذا لقيته فجأة، ووردت الماء نقابا إذا هجمت عليه من غير طلب
يدخل فيه النقاب بمعنى البطن، والمثل فرخان في نقاب أي في بطن واحد أو في اثنين يتشابهان

root_profile.summary: Kök, bir yüzeyi delip ötesine ulaşma çekirdeğinden dağ geçidine, bölgeleri dolaşıp araştırmaya ve gizli bilgiye nüfuz eden kişiye uzanır; bunun yanında hastalık, aşınma, pas, topluluk görevi, iç yapı ve uğur, övülesi özellik, dış görünüş, yüz örtüsü, giysi, beklenmedik karşılaşma ve kalıplaşmış benzerlik gibi birbirinden ayrışmış dallar taşır.
